question: What is the smallest deterministic observation that can distinguish insufficient same-fight Ward/Warden's-Edge availability from a policy play-selection bottleneck after the natural co-play opportunity gate failed at 13 of 64 policies?

eligibilityCriteria.directDiscriminator: The observation must distinguish same-fight card availability from downstream play selection without a payoff or candidate.
eligibilityCriteria.existingDeterministicEvent: Every field must already exist on one deterministic event consumed by the current observation loop.
eligibilityCriteria.identityAnchor: The exact clean current-main explicit-null trace must be available for a full-cohort no-other-field identity comparison.
eligibilityCriteria.unclosed: The observation surface must not reopen upgrade telemetry, acquisition tuning, Ward priority, a closed structural family or a payoff.

surfaces.mediator: A concrete CardInst is drawn into hand in a known fight before any later play-selection claim.
surfaces.interpretation: Robust same-fight draw co-availability below 16 is a hand/deck-cycle substrate failure. Draw co-availability at or above 16 with co-play below 16 isolates downstream play selection. Neither case proves package activation or payoff.

surfaces.mediator: The complete hand and legal-action set at every pilot choice.
surfaces.hook: Would require a new pilot decision-loop hook rather than reuse the current harvested event.
surfaces.interpretation: More detailed than needed for the current draw-versus-play question and therefore not selected.

surfaces.mediator: Warden's Edge is offered, accepted or present in the terminal deck.
surfaces.hook: Existing cardRewards trace and terminal deckIds.
surfaces.interpretation: Cannot establish that Ward and Warden's Edge were available in the same fight, so it cannot separate draw availability from play selection.

scorelinePayoff.status: Separate fixed factor; not observed or varied.

afterimagePayoff.status: Separate fixed factor; not observed or varied.

acquisitionPriority.status: Fixed; existing acquisition events are not interpreted as a causal acquisition effect.

wardSetupPriority.status: Fixed; no non-null research knob exists.

observationSurface.status: This zero-row audit may select at most one telemetry surface for a later identity preflight.

factorDisposition.causalRows: None are authorised by this audit.
factorDisposition.additionalMethod: No ML, RL, optimiser or fitted model. The current failure is substrate opportunity, not yet a proved policy-repertoire bottleneck.
factorDisposition.closedEvidence: Upgrade telemetry and every completed structural family remain closed; fight-scoped draw events are a new observation field, not a repair or rerun of upgrade telemetry.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one surface passes every direct-discriminator, existing-event, single-hook, four-field, identity-anchor and unclosed gate within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze exactly fight-scoped draw events for one separately preregistered full-cohort identity preflight against the clean current-main explicit-null trace. Add only a draws container with fight, event, id and uid. Do not add a candidate, payoff, gameplay hook, policy knob, causal row, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close the observed opportunity-decomposition surfaces. Continue inside issue #421 with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism; do not widen telemetry or guess a policy method.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The fixed source or decision is unavailable at the 30-second cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the audit inconclusive. Add no field, row, repair, rerun, candidate, method or protected seed.
